title: Childress Squat Test
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Ask the patient to squat down as far as they comfortably can, with support available.
Ask them to hold the position and then to rock or waddle forwards a short distance in the squat.
Do not persist if the patient cannot squat safely, and record the inability rather than forcing it.
